ObjectName: Olympic Road Race Womens winners, London - July 2012
ImageDescription: The three medal winners of the Womens Olympic Road Race in London as they pass by Upper Richmond Road in South West London, approximately 10km from the finish. From left to right: Lizzie Armitstead, Marianne Vos and Olga Zabelinskaya.
